resolution.title: the Assimilated
resolution.label: Accept comfort.
lines: Warm, safe, dim. The dead drop sits inside you like a seed. Someday — years from now, patient as roots — the food truth will sprout in the galactic core, and no one will remember who carried it in. You will. That's enough. That's everything.
You came to the Table as the Assimilated the hard way: one fight at a time, most of them for someone else.
Before dawn, you had walked the fence again. It was a good fence. You knew it did not need walking. You had needed to make sure.

Accept comfort.

At the Table

Warm, safe, dim. The dead drop sits inside you like a seed. Someday — years from now, patient as roots — the food truth will sprout in the galactic core, and no one will remember who carried it in. You will. That's enough. That's everything.

You came to the Table as the Assimilated the hard way: one fight at a time, most of them for someone else.

Before dawn, you had walked the fence again. It was a good fence. You knew it did not need walking. You had needed to make sure.
